title: Fable 5.1 "kinda" cheetah challenge
author: Maniick
selftext:
So u/bGivenb posted "I tried the GPT-6 cheetah challenge with a reference video. Here’s what it produced." and someone wanted to know how claude would do. I didn't ask it to do all the work the OP posted, just provided a link to their post and said I wanna see what you do. Now claude does acknowledge that this is just a goofy low poly quick spin up instead of a photorealistic high-fidelity one. 

But honestly for not asking it to do any research, not downloading a model, or giving it a reference video past looking at the original post, this is almost usable. ;p

replies.author: Maniick
replies.body:
something that was generated from a single sentence and a link to a reddit post :3 



The model is goofy as hell for sure, claude even says such in the output, but the animation itself looks way better I think, def needs a little touchup still, the back paws don't hit the ground and such. but for throwing together it's own model from scratch and not having a video reference i think it did a pretty good job finding out how a cheetah actually runs and trying to implement their unique gait.
